resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Norwegian Bokmål source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Norwegian Bokmål pass identified 25 actionable terminology, grammar, technical-clarity, heat-flux, and safety-wording defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Norwegian Bokmål human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The example formula used decimal points inside otherwise Norwegian prose and units.
evidence: The previous formula was I = 4.2 V / 1.0 Ω = 4.2 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Norwegian decimal commas: I = 4,2 V / 1,0 Ω = 4,2 A.

findings.summary: The summary said electrical current converted resistance to heat rather than electrical energy.
evidence: The previous summary was Hvordan elektrisk strøm omdanner motstand til varme.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to describe electrical energy becoming heat when current passes through resistance.

findings.summary: The heating-power heading used an awkward literal form.
evidence: The previous title was Oppvarmingseffekt.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the more precise Varmeeffekt.

findings.summary: The coil setup used fører for current in a way that is less natural in technical Norwegian.
evidence: The previous setup was En spole på 0,8 Ω fører 3 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a coil conducting a current of 3 A.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet used maskinvare for hardware.
evidence: The previous text referred to varmeoverføring til luft, væske og maskinvare.
findings.resolution: Changed maskinvare to the technical term utstyr.

findings.summary: The paragraph used varmestrøm instead of the more precise heat-flux-density term.
evidence: The previous text paired Varmekapasitet og varmestrøm with energy leaving a surface.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with varmeflukstetthet and clearer transfer-rate wording.

findings.summary: The safety paragraph used a generic margin rather than explicitly naming a safety margin.
evidence: The previous text said Legg inn tilstrekkelig margin.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a sufficient sikkerhetsmargin and clarified the safety instruction.

findings.summary: The circuit-terms heading was a compressed compound that is less clear to readers.
evidence: The previous title was Kretstermer.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Termer i elektriske kretser.

findings.summary: The current-law example used regner rather than explicitly describing solving the circuit.
evidence: The previous text said Velg strømretninger før du regner.
findings.resolution: Changed it to before solving the circuit while retaining the sign interpretation.

findings.summary: The parallel-resistor conclusion was understandable but less explicit about branch current.
evidence: The previous text was Når grenmotstandene er like, fører hver gren 10 A.
findings.resolution: Changed it to state that each branch has a current of 10 A.

findings.summary: The voltage-law paragraph used a less direct construction for the relationship between series resistance and voltage drop.
evidence: The previous text said En større seriemotstand får et større spenningsfall.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer En større seriemotstand gir et større spenningsfall.

findings.summary: The cell heading did not use the most natural Norwegian compound for series and parallel cells.
evidence: The previous title was Celler i serie og parallell.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Serie- og parallellkoblede celler.

findings.summary: The series-cell capacity sentence was ambiguous about which cell capacity is retained.
evidence: The previous text said kapasiteten i amperetimer tilsvarer én lik celle.
findings.resolution: Clarified that it matches one cell with the same capacity.

findings.summary: The charging warning used a compound without the standard hyphenated lithium-ion spelling.
evidence: The previous text was Seriekoblede litiumioneceller.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Seriekoblede litium-ion-celler.

findings.summary: The limits paragraph used sterkstrømskrets, which is less direct for this context.
evidence: The previous text ended with en sterkstrømskrets.
findings.resolution: Changed it to a circuit with high current.

findings.summary: The TCR summary narrowed the concept to a conductor even though the content is about materials generally.
evidence: The previous summary was Hvordan temperatur endrer motstanden i en leder.
findings.resolution: Changed it to temperature changing resistance in a material.

findings.summary: The TCR limitations paragraph used reelt resultat instead of the more natural faktiske resultatet.
evidence: The previous text said et virkelig resultat avviker fra førsteordensestimatet.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with faktiske resultatet and retained the uncertainty factors.

findings.summary: The triangle explanation was technically correct but overly repetitive and could be clearer in Norwegian.
evidence: The previous text repeated relative-side descriptions across a long sentence.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with concise definitions for opposite, adjacent, hypotenuse, and SOH-CAH-TOA.

findings.summary: The setup used danner en vinkel, which is less precise for a hypotenuse lying opposite an angle.
evidence: The previous overlay text was En hypotenuse på 10 cm danner en vinkel på 30°.
findings.resolution: Changed it to state that the hypotenuse lies opposite a 30° angle.

findings.summary: The object/material heading used kontra, which sounds adversarial rather than comparative.
evidence: The previous title was Objekt kontra materiale.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Objekt og materiale.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name did not make the per-area density explicit.
evidence: The previous display name was Varmefluks.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Varmeflukstetthet.

findings.summary: The definition did not explicitly include the time dimension in heat-flux density.
evidence: The previous text described heat transfer per area but not per time.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as heat transfer per time and area.

findings.summary: The electrical-power paragraph used termisk kapasitet where heat-dissipation capability was intended.
evidence: The previous paragraph used tilstrekkelig termisk kapasitet and sikkerhetsmargin for a component that must dissipate heat.
findings.resolution: Changed it to tilstrekkelig varmeavledningsevne with a clear safety-margin statement.

findings.summary: The gauge-number sentence used a slightly awkward phrasing for sizes above gauge zero.
evidence: The previous corrected text said størrelser over dimensjon 0 bruker 00, 000 eller 0000.
findings.resolution: Changed it to say those sizes are written as 00, 000, or 0000.

findings.summary: The latent-heat sentence needed a natural definite form in Norwegian.
evidence: The previous text was L er spesifikk latent varme i J/kg.
findings.resolution: Changed it to L er den spesifikke latente varmen i J/kg.
